claim_boundary: Declared exploratory extension after inspection of previous results; not an untouched-test confirmatory experiment, a historical calibration recovery, or a paper-exact replication.

representation.authority: pinned compiled_unified R2 representation rows and per-graph hashes

row4477_method_policy.graph_or_instruction_dependent: unavailable because the flat DAG omits dynamic branch semantics
row4477_method_policy.metadata_only_controls: predict when their saved global features and shots are valid; keep this as a rare-control-flow stress case, not branch-aware inference

representation.qpack_qualification: reconstruction-qualified representative QAOA inputs; archived labels are not fabricated
representation.qonductor_qualification: exact submitted physical circuits; do not declare all logical circuits recovered
representation.mali_qualification: exact logical inputs followed by the already saved nominal target compilation

calibration.nominal: frozen registry; validate actual asset hashes before access

kyoto_composite.header_normalization: strip leading/trailing whitespace only; then exact field match

hyb.bucket_mean: operation-weighted arithmetic mean; repeated operations contribute repeatedly
hyb.individual_error_one: record count; not automatically bucket zero-survival if bucket mean is below one
hyb.zero_survival: nonempty bucket has mean_error exactly one; log cost unavailable, never impute
hyb.T2_eff: minimum finite positive T2 of quantum operands of all retained non-directive instructions
hyb.gate_time: serial sum of used 1Q/2Q gate and measurement durations; virtual zero durations allowed; total must be positive
hyb.routing: already present in saved physical circuit; do not add a second routing duration
hyb.float64_exp_overflow: finite analytical log remains eligible for calibrated log-cost variant; raw exponential variant records overflow
hyb.shot_cost_materialization: compute log_cost + log(shots) before exp; require positive integer canonical shots

ridge.prediction_transform: expm1; floor negative predictions to zero; never upper-clip; nonfinite output is failed
ridge.gate_time_control_eligibility: requires only valid used durations, positive gate time and shots; never inherit noise/T2/zero-survival exclusions from log-cost variant
ridge.selection: lowest mean source-balanced MAE over all four frozen inner folds; ties choose smaller alpha
ridge.scaler_fit_scope: inner-fit for tuning, complete eligible outer-train for final refit
ridge.unsupported_empty_training_partition: record unavailable; never train on outer-test or silently discard inner folds

qcre_rank.weight_map: mean SI duration for each unitary gate name across supported entries of that backend's frozen Target, divided by largest positive gate-name mean
qcre_rank.critical_path: longest sum of gate-name weights over quantum-wire dependencies; keep wire connectivity through excluded nodes
qcre_rank.virtual_rz_zero: only if the frozen Target supplies zero duration, not because duration is missing

scholten.depth: longest unweighted quantum-wire path on saved R2 graph, excluding barrier/snapshot, including measure/reset/delay; not claimed quantum-volume effective depth
scholten.candidate_rule: do not add an active entry without verifying its numerical value and definition in the cited primary source and revising this protocol before scoring
scholten.old_six_backend_nominal_variant: retain its existing independent ID and results; do not silently merge definition-unspecified entries into it

execution.future_authorization: user requests implementation/execution of this bounded queue
execution.preflight_selection: ten rows per source/backend cell sorted by SHA256(canonical_row_id), or all if smaller; add three largest-operation rows per cell and mandatory_preflight_ids; no target-label selection
automatic_acceptance: row4477 unavailable only for methods requiring the missing graph; metadata-only controls predict from saved globals when valid
paired old/new calibration uses identical representation digest
every assigned row has one terminal state
all tuning/scaler fits disjoint from outer-test

metrics.source_balanced_macro: arithmetic mean of source-local metrics; show source row/group counts; never average an undefined metric as zero
metrics.common_pairs: same successful outer-test identities; print row-set SHA256 and excluded identities/reasons
metrics.full_envelope: 8767 attempts for every method, with unavailable/overflow/failed counts; not a promise of 8767 finite predictions

bootstrap.resampling: frozen outer-split groups with replacement within each source; retain all observations of each sampled group
bootstrap.cross_source_group_check: verify frozen groups do not span sources before stratified resampling; otherwise stop for cluster-policy review, not independent source sampling
bootstrap.seed: first four SHA256 bytes as big-endian uint32 of root_seed|bootstrap_stream|protocol_id|sorted_pair_id|0
bootstrap.delta_direction: record method_A minus method_B explicitly, regardless of sorted seed identity
bootstrap.point_estimate: direct observed metric delta; report bootstrap mean separately

metrics.R2_undefined: fewer than two observations or zero target variance: null with reason
metrics.simulator_table: retain existing frozen per-engine/context metrics and quality constraints; no new simulator measurements or pooling of different clocks

preprocessing_delivery.public_dependency_adapters: portable CLI paths; pin original sources; compare reconstructed features/digests with frozen sidecars before fitting
preprocessing_delivery.latent_two_wire_barrier_count: test and disclose; do not silently change frozen features. Any affected row requires a separate representation revision before scoring.
preprocessing_delivery.missing_source_version: record unreproducible source-rebuild stage explicitly; do not call packaged sidecar replay raw-data reconstruction
